description: 5 exemplars + 3 near-misses + 2 counterexamples. Authored 2026-10-16 under road-to-steps-the-skill-cannot-skip 2.1, which aligned this skill's Killer 5 with the single split rule and so brought it into check_routing_coverage's touched-skill scope. Exemplars cover reviewing, auditing and optimising an existing skill against the Skill Killers, including German. Near-misses share skill vocabulary and belong elsewhere: writing a new skill (skill-writing), running the mechanical linter (lint-skills) and condensing a file (condense). Counterexamples guard 'review' as code review and 'skills' as a person's abilities.

queries.q: review this SKILL.md against the skill killers and tell me what to fix
audit the git-workflow skill — is it too monolithic?
this skill never seems to get applied; what is wrong with it?
optimize the existing design-review skill and give me fix recommendations
prüf diesen Skill auf die typischen Schwächen und schlag Verbesserungen vor
write a new skill for terraform drift detection
run the skill linter on my branch
queries.note: the mechanical gate, not the judgement review → lint-skills

queries.q: condense this skill into telegraph format
queries.note: a transform of the file, not a review of it → condense

queries.q: review my PHP service class for bugs
which skills should a senior backend engineer have?
